# Upcycle That

> > A creative resource for transforming discarded materials into functional home decor, furniture, and accessories through DIY upcycling projects.

Upcycle That showcases innovative ways to repurpose everyday items—from vintage cheese graters and wine bottles to pallets and vinyl records—into stylish, sustainable home goods. The site features tutorials, artist spotlights, and inspiration for budget-conscious makers interested in eco-friendly crafting.

## Key Topics

- DIY decor
- Upcycled furniture
- Home decor
- Pallet projects
- Fabric crafts
- Furniture making
- Vinyl upcycling
- Jewelry storage
- Driftwood crafts
- Repurposed materials
- Sustainable crafting
- Rustic decor
- Budget-friendly projects
- Handmade furniture
- Creative reuse

## Furniture & Home Projects

- [How To: Make a Pallet Wall](https://upcyclethat.com/make-pallet-wall): Step-by-step tutorial for creating reclaimed pallet accent walls
- [Drum Table](https://upcyclethat.com/drum-table): Tutorial for upcycling drums into illuminated furniture tables
- [Pallet Ottoman](https://upcyclethat.com/pallet-ottoman): Painted pallet ottoman with cushion top by BCK design
- [Upcycled Ottoman](https://upcyclethat.com/upcycled-ottoman): DIY pouffe ottoman made from upcycled rugs with storage
- [Whisky Barrel Sink](https://upcyclethat.com/whisky-barrel-sink): Whisky barrel transformed into copper bathroom sink by Jeannell Goines
- [Upcycle a Modern Rustic Decor](https://upcyclethat.com/upcycle-a-modern-rustic-decor): Distressed wood furniture refinishing for modern rustic style

## DIY Decor & Storage

- [DIY Necklace Holder](https://upcyclethat.com/diy-necklace-holder): DIY necklace holder using driftwood and decorative cupboard knobs
- [Wine Bottle Planters](https://upcyclethat.com/wine-bottle-planters): Upcycled wine bottle planters for succulents by Amanda Parker
- [Pencil Holder](https://upcyclethat.com/pencil-holder): Vintage cheese grater repurposed as rustic desk organizer
- [Record Clock Art](https://upcyclethat.com/record-clock): Carved vinyl record clocks by DMT waste art from Croatia
- [Fire Bell Art](https://upcyclethat.com/fire-bell-art): Artist Christina Norberg transforms fire bells into mixed-media art
- [Closet Makeover Tips](https://upcyclethat.com/closet-makeover-tips): Organization tips and storage solutions for closet makeovers

## Fashion & Accessories

- [Upcycled Dress Shirt](https://upcyclethat.com/upcycled-dress-shirt): No-sew tutorial for converting dress shirts into tank tops
- [Cool Backpacks](https://upcyclethat.com/cool-backpacks): Upcycled backpacks from Sealand and UliUlia for back-to-school
- [RUBY: Pamper & Pout Upcycled Jewelry Giveaway!](https://upcyclethat.com/upcycled-jewelry-giveaway): RUBY South African upcycled jewelry giveaway contest

## Creative Repurposing Ideas

- [Vintage Video Game Consoles Reimagined](https://upcyclethat.com/vintage-video-game): Repurposing Atari, NES, and Sega consoles into planters and furniture
- [Doorbell Phone](https://upcyclethat.com/doorbell-phone): Kickstarter project: rotary phone converted to wireless doorbell
- [Repurposing Crossword Puzzles and Games](https://upcyclethat.com/repurposing-crossword-puzzles-and-games): Creative ways to repurpose old crossword puzzles and board games

## Optional

- [Decorating Your Dorm Room](https://upcyclethat.com/decorating-your-dorm-room): Budget-friendly upcycled decor ideas for college dorm rooms
- [Upcycled Sensory Games to Boost Coordination and Balance](https://upcyclethat.com/upcycled-sensory-games): Tactile sensory activities using upcycled materials for child development
